- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisBanksSupported5p4`
- Description: BanksSupported code set as printed by CMIS 5.4 Table 8-47: codes 0-2 keep the 5.3 meanings and code 3 is the escape code indicating that the number of supported banks is defined by the ExtraLaneBanksSupported field at 01h:174.4-0 (module supports more than 32 lanes). CmisBanksSupported keeps the pre-5.4 window, where code 3 is Reserved; this enum is the since-5.4 window. The 5.4 escape was introduced together with the lane-banking expansion to up to 32 banks (CMIS 5.4 § 4.1.1, § 8.4.4).
